### AI Policy

| Aspect | Detail |
|--------|--------|
| **Has journal-specific AI policy?** | *(see summary — defaults to publisher-level policy unless a journal-specific override was found)* |
| **Explicit permission gate?** | conditional |
| **Leniency (1-5)** | 2 |
| **Summary** | Publisher-level (Elsevier) policy applies to this journal (confirmed via its Guide for Authors, which links the same policy): generative AI may be used only to improve language/readability, must be disclosed in a mandatory declaration section before the references, cannot be used to generate scientific insight/analysis/conclusions or to create/alter images (except where AI is itself part of the study's method), and AI tools cannot be listed as authors. This is Elsevier's standard policy, not a journal-specific variant found for IJP. |
| **Source URL** | https://www.elsevier.com/about/policies-and-standards/the-use-of-generative-ai-and-ai-assisted-technologies-in-writing-for-elsevier |
